card: 2 claims, distinct axes (freshness = re-verification of old registry rows against live surfaces; coverage = one new linguistics entry on uncovered dedicated ground), distinct graded paths; C is the sourced claim of the frontier step.

F.name: Live re-verification of the registry's upcoming-recheck queue
F.population_rule: Rows that tools/check-sources-recheck.py --as-of 2026-11-04 --window 90 classes as upcoming at the base revision AND whose source cell carries an http(s) URL (own-work repo-path rows S859, S860, S929, S934 are excluded: they are not live surfaces). Derived at base 42816d25: 20 upcoming, 16 with URLs.
F.predicate: At the lands revision at least 10 of the 16 population rows carry a recheck cell changed from the base value to an ISO date d with 2026-11-04+90d < d <= 2026-11-04+366d; every population row whose recheck changed is backed by a LOCATED line in corpus/lessons/round-89.md naming the id, 'recheck <old>→<new>' (or ->), the access date 2026-11-04 and a double-quoted quote of <=25 words and >=20 normalised characters, and by a committed capture listed in the manifest (sha256 equal, http_status 2xx, fetched_at 2026-11-04, url one of the row's source URLs or a web.archive.org capture of one) whose normalised text contains that quote; every population id has a LOCATED or NOT-LOCATED disposition line; population rows change no other cell and no non-population row changes its recheck cell.
F.before: 0 of 16 population rows re-verified this round; the recheck auditor classes all 20 as upcoming (RECHECK-QUEUE: 0 due / 20 upcoming / 16 on-release / 859 rows at base).
F.after_target: ADVANCED >= 10 of 16, BACKED with zero unbacked changed rows, DISPOSED 16/16, OTHERCELLS no drift
F.kill_rule: Any FAIL leg kills F. One changed population recheck without its LOCATED line, quote, committed capture or manifest entry fails BACKED and kills the claim even if ADVANCED is met; a NOT-LOCATED row is never advanced.
F.bounds: Re-verification means the row's teaching is still locatable at its live (or archived) surface on 2026-11-04 by a quote of the re-verifier's choosing; it does not re-certify the row's tier, scope or the citing entry's use. A capture fabricated with the quote pasted in passes the counter (a committed pre-freeze known-survivor receipt shows this); the independent re-fetch of a non-author seat and the closure's re-open are the only defence and are reported separately.

C.name: Dedicated evidentiality entry in the linguistics partition
C.surface: A dedicated linguistics entry on evidentiality (grammatical marking of information source) and its separation from epistemic modality, as a conlang/culture design system. At base the lane holds only scattered sub-bullets (semantics-pragmatics.md, civilization entries); no dedicated entry exists and the linguistics partition has 33 files. The command that would show it unmoved: git show <lands>:corpus/knowledge/linguistics/evidentiality-epistemic-marking.md fails, or the partition count stays 33.
C.predicate: At the lands revision the entry exists (absent at base), is >= 8000 bytes with >= 5 '## ' headings and the topic/sources/verified-at/recheck header keys, carries a markdown table of >= 3 columns and >= 5 data rows, cites >= 3 S-ids absent from the base registry each present at lands with tier A or B, status mined, opened 2026-11-04 and used-by naming the entry, and cites no id missing from the registry; each such id has a corpus/lessons/round-89.md line with a row URL, 2026-11-04 and a <=25-word quote that occurs in its committed evidence capture (manifest sha256/2xx/date/url checked); corpus/README.md has the entry's index row and the freeze-pinned tools/check-corpus-index.py exits 0 over a git archive of lands; no base registry row changes a cell other than status, recheck or used-by.
C.before: Entry absent; partition linguistics 33 files; 0 new ids.
C.after_target: ENTRY, TABLE, NEWIDS (>=3), GATE, CAPTURE, INDEX, APPENDONLY all PASS
C.kill_rule: Any FAIL leg kills C. A cited id not in the registry fails NEWIDS outright; a qualifying id without gate line or capture fails GATE/CAPTURE.
C.bounds: Coverage of one dedicated topic, method and design reference, non-canon. Structure and source binding are counted, not the scholarly truth of each typological statement; the closure's source re-open is the content check. Does not absorb chousa's research method or lore canon.

separability: F reads only population rows' cells in corpus/SOURCES.md, the lesson's LOCATED/NOT-LOCATED lines and reports/round-89/rechecks/. C reads the entry, rows absent at base, the lesson's gate lines, reports/round-89/evidence/, corpus/README.md and the frozen index tool. A sandbox at the freeze overlaid with only one claim's paths (and only that claim's registry cells) must pass that claim; reports/round-89/separability89.py builds both overlays from committed revisions.
lowest_axis: Freshness is the historically lowest non-retired axis; claim F works it directly through source re-verification, a surface that does not depend on the open round-11 L0 drift-threshold question.
